verdict.rationale: Cubic is positioned as an AI code-review platform, not a code-generation/agent product — it reviews PRs, generates PR descriptions, and pushes fixes for issues found in review, but explicitly relies on external 'coding agents' (via MCP or its CLI) to write code and only analyzes whether an existing PR satisfies a linked Linear/Jira issue rather than generating a PR from an issue itself. Turning a tracked issue into a full PR end-to-end is outside cubic's product category (review/QA), so this axis does not apply.
